BiblicalUsage: Ginath is an Israelite. In 1 Kings 16:21, the text says "half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath." The life behind the name is told on the Ginath, Father of Tibni People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ginath matters because God knows His people by name, and Ginath is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
